questions: How many nano-SQUIDs did you fabricate and measure in total, how many showed the global signatures, and how many showed ZBPs? You write that the global signatures "are also observed in all examined devices" (p. 4); the number examined would help.
Why were the other devices set aside, for example devices with one working tunnel probe besides device A?
Which ranges of VG, Bx and field angle did you measure beyond the ones shown, and why were Bx = 0, 1 and 2 T (Fig. 4) and 0, 2.5 and 4 T (Fig. S3) chosen for the gate maps?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example another cooldown of device B, or device A at gate voltages beyond the three in Fig. S1?

In the correlation analysis (Fig. 4c, f, i, l), what threshold separates "correlated" from "no correlation", was the data smoothed before taking third derivatives, and how do the fractions in Fig. 4l move with that threshold?
Do the zero-field ZBPs in Fig. 4a-b show dot or Kondo features, such as alternation between gate valleys, splitting at small Bx, or a temperature dependence?
Could a trivial two-junction SQUID model with your measured asymmetry reproduce the Ic and η curves of Figs. 1e and 3a, and which feature, if any, would it miss?
Which field-sweep direction do Figs. 1f, 3 and S2 show, and do the jumps at half-integer flux sit at the same fields in both directions?
